A 1-flute cutter clears its chip easily: chip load raised. A Ø3.175 1F slotted 6082 8.5 mm deep at 500 mm/min, 0.2 mm a pass (0.042 mm/tooth).

Dry aluminium is limited by heat: stepdown at most 3 mm, less to stay within about 30 W. Brush on a little lubricant (IPA or WD-40) every few minutes. A 6 mm 3-flute ran at 800 mm/min, 3 mm deep, lubricated; 550 at 6 mm, dry, welded a flute.
Lubricated: stepdown up to 1 × D (3 mm at most). A Ø1 ran 1 mm deep at 92 mm/min and a Ø3.175 3 mm at 300, both lubricated, in 6082.
